before:
`flask.app.Flask.make_response` documents the return types a view may use:
`str`, `bytes`, `dict`, `tuple`, `Response`, and a WSGI callable. A lazily
produced body has to be wrapped in a `Response` by the view itself.
after:
`flask.app.Flask.make_response` documents the return types a view may use:
`str`, `bytes`, `dict`, `tuple`, `Response`, a generator/iterator, and a WSGI
callable. A generator or iterator returning `str`/`bytes` is now converted
directly into a streaming `Response` by `make_response` itself — the view no
longer has to wrap a lazily produced body.
